findings.detail: The Recommendations section lists actions but gives little explanation of why they suit the stated objective. It also leaves the contribution and investment amounts unresolved, although the specification requires amounts.
report_quote: We recommend using both ISA allowances for the new tax year and making pension contributions into both SIPPs up to the appropriate level. [ADVISER TO CONFIRM #7: SIPP contribution amounts]
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly held investment account. [ADVISER TO CONFIRM #10: the balance placed into the new account]

findings.detail: The meeting note makes the approximately three-year timeframe central to assessing the advice; the report drops it. It also does not distinguish the completion money available after the committed bridging-loan repayment from the contingent, unpaid earnout when discussing the remaining balance.
report_quote: Their priority is to build a tax-efficient base that can replace James’s income when he steps back from full-time work, and recommendations should be assessed against this objective.
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly held investment account.

findings.detail: The report silently ignores the handling note’s warning that the sale proceeds arrive in different forms and at different times. It does not explain the unpaid, contingent earnout or the committed loan repayment before recommending investment of a remaining balance. It does not leak the internal guidance’s wording.
report_quote: James has completed the sale of his company, and he and Caroline seek long-term growth with a balanced-to-moderate approach to risk.
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly held investment account.

findings.detail: With several investments in the report, ‘the other investment’ does not identify the offshore bond clearly. The initial-charge sentence does not say what the charge applies to.
report_quote: We recommend leaving the other investment as it is for now and revisiting it at the next review.
The initial charge that applies is 0.5%.

findings.detail: The SIPP marker should request separate contribution amounts for James and Caroline. The new-account marker identifies the account but does not specify which charges or rates need confirming.
report_quote: [ADVISER TO CONFIRM #5: charges on the new joint account]
